target.title: fix(extensions/msteams): bound Graph collection JSON response read to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`fetchGraphCollection` in the MS Teams attachment graph helper called `response.json()` directly on Microsoft Graph collection endpoints. A runaway response body could be buffered without limit, leading to OOM while resolving Teams message attachments.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use `readProviderJsonResponse` from the plugin SDK to bound the JSON read to 16 MiB. If the response is larger, the existing catch path returns an empty item list, which keeps attachment resolution fail-closed instead of crashing. This follows the same bounded-read pattern as OpenRouter OAuth (#98645), Google OAuth (#97587), and QA bus (#99169).

## User Impact

Teams channel/chat attachment resolution is protected from unexpectedly large Graph API responses.

## Evidence

- Regression test added in `extensions/msteams/src/attachments/graph.test.ts`: returns a >16 MiB `hostedContents` collection and asserts no media/hosted content is resolved.
- Local verification:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/attachments/graph.test.ts` passes.
  - `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/msteams/src/attachments/graph.ts extensions/msteams/src/attachments/graph.test.ts` passes.
